integrity: Uniform proof by explicit link collapses, contractible-cover suspension and natural integral Mayer–Vietoris; standalone finite replay corroborates \(m=3,4,5\) but is not a proof for all m.
scientific_limitations: Uniform result for quadrilateral books of \(m\ge3\) pages at induced-component cutoff 3 only; neither an equivariant homotopy decomposition nor other cutoffs are established. Literature coverage is bounded; independent verification is not available.
title: Three-independence topology and integral symmetries of quadrilateral books
